components.css: .ds-sign{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;grid-template-areas:'name name' 'act meta';row-gap:10px;column-gap:16px;align-items:end;padding:22px 26px;border-radius:16px;background:#e9ebe6;color:#121315;text-decoration:none;font-family:Barlow,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #e9ebe6,inset 0 0 0 5px #121315,0 10px 18px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.7);transition:background-color .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform .2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-sign:hover{background:#f2c14e;transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #f2c14e,inset 0 0 0 5px #121315,0 14px 22px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.75)}.ds-sign:active{background:#121315;color:#e9ebe6;transform:none}.ds-sign:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f2c14e;outline-offset:3px}.ds-sign__name{grid-area:name;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.35em;font-family:'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:3rem;line-height:.95;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-sign__no{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:1.05em;height:1.05em;border-radius:50%;background:#121315;color:#e9ebe6;font-size:.82em}.ds-sign__act{grid-area:act;font-weight:600;font-size:1.1rem}.ds-sign__meta{grid-area:meta;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:500;color:#4c4f55}

narrative.overview:
Usage limits are read like a station departure board. Each provider is a service, each reset is a scheduled time, and macOS and Windows are the two platforms you board from. The top of the page is the hall: a black board housing with split-flap tiles in flap yellow. Everything below it is station enamel signage: off-white enamel, black lettering, rounded plate corners, ruled ledgers.

Density is high and orderly, like a timetable. Hierarchy comes from condensed uppercase signage and heavy rules, not from cards or gradients. Colour is literal to the world: yellow is flap ink, red is a low-limit signal, and nothing glows without a reason.
keyCharacteristics: Two material zones: dark housing (board, header, footer) and light enamel (content).
Split-flap tiles with a lighter top leaf, darker bottom leaf and a hairline split.
Condensed signage grotesque for every heading and label, its regular cut for reading text.
Ruled ledgers (2px ink top rule, 1px enamel-rule dividers) instead of card grids.

rules.name: The Signal Only Rule
rules.body: Red appears only to mean a low limit or an alert. Never decorative.

rules.name: The Flap Ink Rule
rules.body: Yellow is the colour of characters on the board and of interaction (hover, focus, selection). It is not a fill for large enamel areas, except a platform sign under the pointer.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every digit on the page is tabular; times and percentages must not shift when they change.

rules.name: The Signage Case Rule
rules.body: Condensed type is set uppercase; Barlow reading text is never uppercase.

rules.name: The Object Depth Rule
rules.body: Only things that exist physically in a station cast shadows. Text blocks, ledgers and sections stay flat.

dos: Do keep the housing / enamel split: dark for the board, header and footer; enamel for content.
Do set headings as uppercase Barlow Condensed and reading text in Barlow with tabular digits.
Do use flap yellow (`#f2c14e`) for board characters, hover and focus (3px outline, 3px offset).
Do structure lists with ruled ledgers (2px ink top, 1px dividers).
Do honour reduced motion: no flap riffle, no sign lift.
donts: Don't use signal red for anything but a low limit or an alert.
Don't add shadows to text blocks, sections or lists; depth belongs to board objects and signs.
Don't set Barlow reading text in uppercase or condensed type in sentence-case body.
Don't apply this system to the Flutter app in `lib/`.
